action.command:
for c in "ki-guv-ai-testing:ai_testing_api" "ki-guv-explainability:explainability_transparency_api" "dokumentenschwaerzung-orchestrator:dokumentenschwaerzung_orchestrator" "dokumentenschwaerzung-pdf-pii-detector:dokumentenschwaerzung_pdf_pii_detector" "demos-einwendungsmanagement:demos_einwendungsmanagement" "kommentar-service:kommentar_service" "fristenmanagement:fristenmanagement"; do
  img=${c%%:*}; mod=${c##*:}
  printf "%-42s " "$img"
  timeout 50 docker run --rm --entrypoint sh "$img" -c "/app/.venv/bin/python -c 'import ${mod}; print(\"import ok\")' 2>&1 | tail -1" 2>/dev/null
done

tool_call.name: terminal
